title: DANGEROUS MIDNIGHT PRAYERS FOR UNSTOPPABLE FAVOUR AND ACCELERATION
text: Somebody shout hallelujah. I welcome you into this sacred atmosphere where heaven and earth are about to collide. This is not an ordinary prayer session. This is a divine appointment orchestrated by the spirit of the living God. The angels of the Lord have already taken their positions. And I can sense in my spirit that there are people under the sound of my voice whose lives are about to experience a supernatural shift that will defy every natural explanation. Before the sun rises again, somebody is going to receive a testimony that will make demons tremble and angels rejoice. The Bible says in Psalm 119-62. At midnight, I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments. There is something profoundly significant about midnight prayers. Midnight represents the darkest hour, but it is also the gateway into a new day. It is the moment when God releases fresh mercies, new beginnings, and uncommon breakthroughs. When Paul and Silas prayed at midnight in Acts 16:25, the prison foundations were shaken, chains fell off, and doors flew open. That same power is available tonight, and we're about to engage it with spiritual violence and holy aggression. I want you to understand something very clearly. The favor we are contending for tonight is not ordinary favor. This is unstoppable favor. The kind that opens doors that no man can shut. The kind that makes kings and presidents become your advocates. The kind that causes your enemies to become your foottool. Isaiah 60 to10 declares, "And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee. For in my wrath I smoke thee, but in my favor have I had mercy on thee." This is divine acceleration where you will accomplish in months what would have ordinarily taken you decades. Are you ready to pray? Then lift up your voice right now. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I come before your throne of grace with boldness, not because of my righteousness, but because of the blood of the everlasting covenant that speaks better things than the blood of Abel. I thank you for the privilege of prayer, for the authority you have given us to decree a thing and it shall be established. Tonight, we are not coming as beggars. who are coming as kings and priests unto God, enforcing the finished works of Calvary. I decree and declare that every satanic agenda against the lives of those praying right now is nullified, cancelled, and rendered completely powerless in the mighty name of Jesus. Lord, I thank you because your word in Jeremiah 33:3 says, "Call unto me, and I will answer thee and show thee great and mighty things which thou knowest not." We're calling upon you tonight and we're expecting answers that will astound us. Answers that will leave us speechless. Answers that will cause us to testify of your goodness for the rest of our lives. Every delayed answer to prayer, every postponed breakthrough, every suspended miracle, I command you to manifest now in the name of Jesus Christ. By the power of the blood of Jesus, I decree and declare unstoppable favor upon every life connected to this prayer. The favor that made Joseph go from the prison to the palace in one day. The favor that made Esther find grace before the king. The favor that made Ruth marry Boas and become part of the lineage of Jesus Christ. I release that dimension of favor upon you right now. Every door that has been shut against you, I command it to fly open in the mighty name of Jesus. Every opportunity that has passed you by, I decree a supernatural recall in the name of Jesus Christ. Let me tell you something. There are people praying right now who have been struggling, working hard, sewing seeds, yet it seems like nothing is happening. But the spirit of God says to you tonight, your season of struggle is over. The years of toiling without results have come to an end. I am about to accelerate your progress in a way that will shock you. Divine acceleration is coming upon your life. What you have been praying for for years, God is going to answer in days. What you have been believing for for months, God is going to manifest in hours. This is your hour of supernatural speed. In the name of Jesus Christ, I take authority over every spirit of delay operating in your life. Every demon assigned to postpone your breakthroughs, I bind you and cast you into the abyss in the name of Jesus. Every satanic conspiracy holding back your promotion, holding back your healing, holding back your marriage, holding back your financial breakthrough, I destroy that conspiracy right now by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Let fire fall upon every evil altar erected against [music] your destiny in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Proverbs 3:3-4 says, "Let not mercy and truth forsake thee. Bind them about thy neck. Write them upon the table of thine heart. So shalt thou find favor and good understanding in the sight [music] of God and man. I decree that you shall find favor in the sight of God and man. Every eye that looks upon you shall see something different. Every authority that encounters you shall be compelled by divine influence to show you favor. The favor of God is settling upon your life like the morning dew and it shall be evident to everyone around you. Father, I pray for divine acceleration in every area. Stagnation. Where there has been stagnation in career, I command acceleration in the name of Jesus. Where there has been stagnation in business, I command supernatural growth in the name of Jesus. Where there has been stagnation in academics, I release the spirit of wisdom and excellence upon you right now. Where there has been stagnation in ministry, I decree that your influence shall suddenly expand, your impact shall suddenly multiply and your effectiveness shall suddenly increase in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I come against every spirit of backwardness in the name of Jesus. Every power dragging you backward when you should be moving forward, I command that power to be destroyed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every evil hand pulling you down when you are supposed to be rising up, I command that hand to wither by the power of the Holy Ghost. You will not go backward. You will not remain stagnant. You will move forward with supernatural speed in the name of Jesus Christ. Thus say the spirit of the living God. There is someone praying right now and you have been faithful in the small things, but you have been wondering when your breakthrough will come. [music] The Lord says to you, "Your time has come. I am about to promote you suddenly. I am about to open doors for you. Suddenly I am about to connect you with divine helpers. Suddenly what you are about to experience will not make sense to your natural mind but it is my doing and it shall be marvelous in your eyes. Receive it in the name of Jesus. By the power of the blood of Jesus, I decree and declare that every curse walking against your life is broken right now. Every generational curse that has been limiting your progress, I destroy it by the blood of Jesus. Every word c spoken against you by witches and wizards, I nullify it by the blood of Jesus. [music] Every self-imposed c through negative words you have spoken over your own life, I cancel it right now in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. You are blessed and not cursed. You are above only and not beneath. You are the head and not the tail in the name of Jesus. Deuteronomy 28-13 declares, "And the Lord shall make thee the head and not the tail, and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath, if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the Lord thy God." Tonight I am enforcing this scripture over your life. [music] You are the head in your family, you are the head in your workplace, you are the head in your business, you are the head in your generation. every force trying to make you the tail, I destroy that force by fire in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Father, I release the spirit of favor upon every business and career represented here tonight. [music] Every business struggling to survive, I decree supernatural turnaround in the name of Jesus. Every career that has hit a dead end, I decree divine reopening in the name of Jesus. The Lord is going to bring customers you did not advertise to. The Lord is going to bring contracts you did not apply for. The Lord is going to bring opportunities you did not lobby for. This is the season of effortless breakthroughs and you are a candidate for it in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I take authority over the spirit of poverty in the name of Jesus. Every demon of lack assigned to your life, I bind you and cast you out right now. Every spirit of financial struggle, I command you to lose your hold and let this person go in the name of Jesus. The Bible says in Philippians 4:19, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. I decree that your needs are met, your bills are paid, your debts are canceled, and your accounts are replenished in the mighty name of Jesus Christ." Let me prophesy to somebody here. The spirit of God says, "There is someone listening to me right now and you have been battling with a particular financial crisis. You have been wondering how you will pay a certain debt, how you will meet a certain obligation, how you will handle a certain financial emergency. The Lord says to you tonight before this month runs out, I will surprise you with provision from an unexpected source. Money you were not expecting will locate you. Help you were not looking for will find you. I'm your provider and I will not fail you. Shout hallelujah if you receive this word. By the authority of heaven, I command every satanic embgo placed upon your finances to be lifted right now in the name of Jesus. Every evil covenant blocking your financial breakthrough, I destroy it by the blood of Jesus. Every witchcraft manipulation affecting your income, affecting your business, affecting your investments, I destroy it by fire in the name of Jesus. Every arrow of poverty fired into your life, I command it to go back to the sender in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I decree and declare that you shall lend to nations and not borrow. You shall be a lender and not a borrower. The wealth of the sinner is laid up for you and you shall begin to experience divine transfers of wealth in the name of Jesus. Every good thing that the enemy has stolen from you, the Bible says in Joel 2:25, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten, I decree restoration upon your life right now. Everything the enemy has stolen, God is restoring it with interest in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Father, I pray for everyone battling with sickness and disease." The Bible says in Exodus 15:26, "I am the Lord that health thee. I decree by the stripes of Jesus, you are healed. [music] Every sickness in your body, I command it to die in the name of Jesus. Every disease eating up your organs, I command it to dry up from the roots in the name of Jesus. [music] Cancer, die in the name of Jesus. Diabetes, lose your hold in the name of Jesus. High blood pressure, I command you to normalize right now in the name of Jesus. Every pain in your body, I command it to disappear in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. By the power of the Holy Ghost, I release healing virtue into every organ of your body. Your heart be healed in the name of Jesus. Your kidneys be restored in the name of Jesus. Your liver function properly in the name of Jesus. Your lungs receive healing in the name of Jesus. Your blood be purified in the name of Jesus. From the crown of your head to the sole of your feet, I decree total wholeness in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I take authority over every infirmity that doctors have called incurable. What is impossible with man is possible with God. The same Jesus who healed the lepers, who opened blind eyes, who made the lame to walk, who raised the dead, that same Jesus is alive today and his power has not diminished. I decree that you will receive your healing tonight. I decree that you will receive your miracle tonight. The report shall change in your favor in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. [music] There is somebody here and the doctors have given you a negative report. The doctors have said there is no hope. The doctors have said you have limited time. [music] But the spirit of God says to you tonight, I am the God of the 11th hour. I specialize in impossible cases. What the doctors have said is not my final word. I am about to shock them with your testimony. I am about to prove myself strong on your behalf. Receive your healing now in [clears throat] the name of Jesus. If that is you, place your hand wherever you are feeling pain or discomfort and receive your healing right now in the name of Jesus Christ. By the blood of Jesus, I destroy every evil plantation in your body. Every sickness planted by witchcraft, come out by fire in the name of Jesus. Every disease introduced through food, through handshakes, through evil touches, I command it to be uprooted right now in the name of Jesus. Every satanic deposit in your body, I command it to melt away like wax before fire in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I decree and declare divine health upon your life. From today, you will not be sick. From today, you will not be weak. From today, you will walk in divine health and strength. The joy of the Lord is your strength. The life of God is in you. You are indestructible. You are untouchable. You are unconquerable. Because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world. Shout hallelujah. Father, I pray for marriages that are under attack. Every marriage on the verge of collapse, I decree supernatural restoration in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of divorce working in marriages, I bind you and cast you out in the name of Jesus. >> [music] >> Every third party interference, every external manipulation, I destroy it by fire in the name of Jesus. Love is rekindled, peace is restored, unity is established in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. For those believing God for a life partner, the spirit of God says your waiting is over. The right person that God has ordained for you, that connection is being orchestrated by heaven right now. [music] You will not marry the wrong person. You will not settle for less than God's best. You will marry the one that heaven has approved and your marriage will be a testimony of God's faithfulness. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I decree and declare that your children shall be great. Your children shall serve the Lord. Your children shall not be weward. Your children shall not disgrace you. Your children shall fulfill destiny. Your children shall walk in the fear of the Lord. Every evil pattern affecting children in your family line, I destroy it by the blood of Jesus. Every spirit targeting the destiny of your children, I destroy it by fire in the name of Jesus. Your children shall be mighty on the earth. Your children shall be blessed. Your children shall excel in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Isaiah 54-13 says, "And all thy children shall be taught of the Lord, and great shall be the peace of thy children. I decree that your children shall have divine wisdom. Your children shall have supernatural intelligence. Your children shall excel academically, socially, spiritually, and in every area of their lives. They shall be the head and not the tail. They shall be above only and not beneath in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. By the authority of heaven, I come against every spirit of the antichrist trying to corrupt the minds of your children. Every evil influence in schools, every demonic exposure through the internet, through friends, through entertainment, I neutralize it by the blood of Jesus. I decree that your children are covered by the blood of Jesus. Your children are protected by the fire of God. Your children are surrounded by the angels of the Lord. No weapon formed against them shall prosper in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Let me prophesy to someone right now. The spirit of God says there is a woman praying and you have been barren for years. You have cried many tears. You have been mocked and ridiculed. You have gone from hospital to hospital, from doctor to doctor. But the Lord says to you tonight, this is your year of conception. This is your year of fruitfulness. I am opening your womb right now. Before this time next year, you shall carry your baby in your arms. Your shame is over. Your reproach is removed. You shall laugh and dance with your testimony. Receive it in the name of Jesus. By the power of the Holy Ghost, I command every closed womb to open right now in the name of Jesus. Every [music] blocked fallopian tube be open in the name of Jesus. Every fibroid dissolve in the name of Jesus. Every hormonal imbalance be corrected in the name of Jesus. Every medical condition preventing conception be healed right now in the name of Jesus. The fruit of the womb is the reward of the Lord. You shall be fruitful and multiply in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Father, I pray for destinies that have been caged. Every destiny under bondage, I decree liberation right now in the name of Jesus. Every evil covenant holding anyone's destiny captive, I destroy that covenant by the blood of Jesus. Every satanic shrine where your name has been mentioned, I command fire to fall upon that shrine and burn it to ashes in the name of Jesus. Every witchcraft gathering where your progress has been arrested, I scatter that gathering by the thunder of God in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I take authority over household wickedness in the name of Jesus. Every jealous relative walking against your progress, the Lord will expose them and disgrace them in the name of Jesus. Every family member using witchcraft to monitor and manipulate your life, I command blindness to come upon them in the name of Jesus. They shall not see you anymore. They shall not locate you anymore. They shall not be able to harm you anymore in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. By the blood of Jesus, I disconnect you from every evil family pattern. Every cycle of poverty in your family, you are free from it in [music] the name of Jesus. Every cycle of untimely death in your family, you are free from it in the name of Jesus. Every cycle of marital failure in your family, you are free from it in the name of Jesus. You are a new creation in Christ Jesus. Old things have passed away. All things have become new. You shall write a new story. You shall set a new standard. You shall break every negative record in your family line in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. [music] Galatians 3:13 declares, "Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us. I enforce this redemption over your life right now. You are redeemed from every cause. You are redeemed from every bondage. You are redeemed from every limitation. You are redeemed from every manipulation. You are free indeed because whom the son sets free is free indeed. Shout hallelujah. I decree and declare that every evil mark placed upon your life is erased by the blood of Jesus. Every spiritual tag identifying you to the kingdom of darkness, I destroy it by fire in the name of Jesus. Every monitoring spirit watching over your life to report your movements to the enemy, I command you to become blind right now in the name of Jesus. You are hidden in Christ Jesus. You are covered by the blood. You are sealed by the Holy Spirit. No weapon of darkness shall prosper against you in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Father, I release angels of breakthrough to go before everyone praying here tonight. Let the angels of the Lord encamp around us. Let the angels fight our battles. Let the angels open doors for us. Let the angels make ways for us where there seems to be no way. In Psalm 91 to11, you promise for he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. I activate this angelic protection and assistance over every life connected to this prayer. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I command every satanic gate erected against your progress to be destroyed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every wall of Jericho standing between you and your breakthroughs, I command that wall to crumble and fall flat right now in the name of Jesus. Every red sea blocking your path, I command it to divide in the name of Jesus. You shall cross over to your promised land. You shall possess your possessions. You shall inherit your inheritance in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. By the authority of heaven, I decree that every evil decree issued against your life is nullified right now in the name of Jesus. Every satanic verdict pronounced over your destiny, I reverse it in the name of Jesus. Every witchcraft manipulation of your destiny, I destroy it by fire in the name of Jesus. What God has said concerning your life shall stand, what heaven has decreed over you shall be established. No power in hell or on earth can stop what God has purposed for you in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Let me tell you what the spirit of God is saying. There is someone here and the enemy has been terrorizing you in your dreams. You have been having terrible nightmares. [music] You have been seeing yourself in your former house, in your village with dead relatives, in terrible situations. The Lord says to you tonight, those dreams are ending tonight. I am giving you victory in the dream realm. From tonight, you will have good dreams. You will see visions of glory. Your nights will be peaceful and restful. Every doorway the enemy has been using to access you in the dream is shut forever in the name of Jesus. >> Receive it and shout hallelujah. By the power of the blood of Jesus, I close every doorway to satanic dreams in your life. Every evil covenant giving the enemy access to your dreams, I destroy it in the name of Jesus. Every witchcraft attack in your dreams, it shall fail in the name of Jesus. Every night arrow, I send it back to the sender in the name of Jesus. Every dream pollution be washed away by the blood of Jesus. Every dream manipulation be nullified in the name of Jesus. You shall sleep and wake up refreshed in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I decree and declare that you shall have dreams of destiny. You shall have dreams of direction. You shall have dreams of warning and protection. Your dreams shall be prophetic and instructive. God shall speak to you in your dreams and give you wisdom, strategy, and revelation. Your night shall become times of divine encounter and spiritual deposit in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Father, I pray for supernatural debt cancellation. Every debt burdening your life, I decree cancellation in the name of Jesus. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 15:1, "At the end of every 7 years, thou shalt make a release. I decree that your debts are released. Your creditors shall have mercy on you. Your financial obligation shall be supernaturally met. You shall come out of debt and into abundance in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I decree that you shall not beg. You shall not borrow. You shall not lack. The Lord is your shepherd. You shall not want. He shall supply all your needs according to his riches in glory. You shall have more than enough. You shall have surplus. You shall have overflow. Your cup shall run over. Your band shall be filled. Your vat shall overflow with new wine in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. By the authority of heaven, I take authority over every demon of financial waste. Every spirit causing you to spend money on unprofitable things, I bind you in the name of Jesus. Every leak in your finances, I seal it by the blood of Jesus. Every hole in your pocket, I close it in the name of Jesus. What you earn shall satisfy you. What you work for shall profit you. Your labor shall not be in vain. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I decree and declare that you are entering into a season of uncommon favor and supernatural increase. What you have been sowing is about to yield a harvest that will astound you. What you have been working on is about to produce results that will shock you. The hand of God is upon you for good. The blessing of God is upon you for breakthrough. The anointing of God is upon you for acceleration. This is your season and nothing shall stop you in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Thus say the Lord, I am doing a new thing in your life. Can you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. Where you have seen obstacles, you shall see opportunities. Where you have experienced resistance, you shall experience acceleration. Where you have known failure, you shall know success. This is a new season. And I am the Lord your God who makes all things new. Receive it in the name of Jesus. By the power of the Holy Ghost, I destroy every spirit of limitation operating in your life. Every boundary that hell has set for you, I [music] destroy it by fire in the name of Jesus. Every ceiling over your life, I break it in the name of Jesus. Every restriction, I remove it in the name of Jesus. You shall go beyond where your parents went. You shall achieve beyond what your peers have achieved. You shall excel beyond expectations. You are limitless in Christ Jesus. You are unstoppable because God is with you in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I decree and declare that your latter shall be greater than your former. Where you have experienced loss, you shall experience restoration with multiplication. Where you have known sorrow, you shall know joy unspeakable and full of glory. Where you have walked in darkness, you shall walk in marvelous light. Your tomorrow shall be better than your yesterday. Your future shall be brighter than your past in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Father, I pray for divine connections. Every person you need to meet to fulfill your destiny, the Lord shall bring them across your path. Every relationship that will take you to the next level, God is orchestrating it right now. Every divine helper assigned to your life, I decree that they shall locate you speedily in the name of Jesus. You shall not struggle alone. You shall not labor in isolation. God shall send people to lift you, people to sponsor you, people to promote you, people to celebrate you in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I take authority over every spirit of rejection in the name of Jesus. Every force making you experience rejection when you should be experiencing acceptance, I destroy that force by fire in the name of Jesus. You are accepted in the beloved. You are chosen by God. You are valuable to heaven. You are precious in God's sight. Men shall accept you. Authority shall celebrate you. Opportunity shall embrace you in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. By the blood of Jesus, I decree that every door that has been shut against you is opening right now. Every opportunity that rejected you is calling you back with better terms. Every door that closed in your face is opening wide for you. The stone that the builders rejected is becoming the head of the corner. What was meant to be your disgrace is becoming your testimony. What was designed to break you is becoming your breakthrough in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I decree and declare that you shall not be forgotten. You shall not be overlooked. You shall not be passed over. When promotions are being shared, your name shall be called. When blessings are being distributed, you shall receive your portion. When favors are being released, you shall be a beneficiary. Your time has come. Your season has arrived. Your moment is now in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Psalm 102:13 says, "Thou shalt arise and have mercy upon Zion, [music] for the time to favor her, yet the set time is come. I decree that your set time of favor has come." This is your appointed time for breakthrough. This is your scheduled season for manifestation. What God has promised you shall come to pass. What heaven has declared over you shall be established. The word of the Lord concerning your life shall be fulfilled speedily in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. By the authority of heaven, I command every good thing pursuing you to catch up with you speedily in the name of Jesus. Every blessing running after you, I decree acceleration in the name of Jesus. Every miracle looking for you, I decree that you are found in the name of Jesus. The blessings of the Lord shall overtake you. The favor of God shall surround you like a shield. The grace of God shall rest upon you mightily in the name of Jesus Christ. Let me prophesy. The spirit of God says there is someone here who has been faithful in giving. You have been sowing seeds consistently even when it didn't make sense financially. The Lord says to you, I have been keeping record of every seed you have sown. I have been marking every sacrifice you have made. Now is your time of harvest. I am about to release a financial breakthrough into your life that will establish you permanently. Get ready to receive what I have been preparing for you. Shout seven hallelujah if you are a giver. By the power of the blood of Jesus, I open the windows of heaven over your life right now. According to Malachi 3:10, bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse that there may be meat in mine house and prove me now herewith, said the Lord of hosts. If I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it. I decree that heaven is opening over you. Blessings are pouring upon you. Provision is flowing to you in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I command every devourer eating up your finances to be rebuked in the name of Jesus. according to Malachi 3:11. And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and it shall not destroy the fruits of your ground, neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, said the Lord of hosts. I decree that the devourer is rebuked. Your investment shall not fail. Your businesses shall not collapse. Your property shall not be wasted. Everything you own is protected by the blood of Jesus. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I decree and declare that you shall eat the good of the land. You shall enjoy the wealth of nations. You shall partake of the riches of the Gentiles. The silver is the Lord's and the gold is the Lord's. And he shall release financial resources into your hands to fulfill kingdom assignments and to live a life of comfort and dignity. You shall not lack any good thing in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Father, I pray for those whose businesses have been struggling, every business on the verge of collapse, I decree divine turnaround in the name of Jesus. Every business losing customers, I decree restoration and multiplication of clientele in the name of Jesus. Every business experiencing financial drought, I decree that streams of income shall begin to flow from unexpected sources in the name of Jesus. Your business shall flourish like the palm tree. [music] Your business shall grow like the cedar of Lebanon in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. By the authority of heaven, I command every evil conspiracy against your business to scatter in [music] the name of Jesus. Every competitor using witchcraft to destroy your business, their plan shall fail in the name of Jesus. Every evil meeting held to pull down your business, I scatter that meeting by thunder and lightning in the name of Jesus. Your business shall not fail. Your business shall not collapse. your business shall prosper and succeed in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I decree and declare that divine ideas shall come to you. Creative strategy shall drop into your spirit. Innovative solution shall be revealed to you. God shall show you what to do, when to do it, and how to do it. You shall have business breakthroughs. You shall have career breakthroughs. You shall have ministry breakthroughs. Everything concerning you shall prosper in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. [music] By the power of the Holy Ghost, I release the spirit of wisdom upon you right now. The wisdom that made Solomon the wisest man on earth, I release it upon you in the name of Jesus. You shall make wise decisions. You shall make profitable investments. You shall enter into beneficial partnerships. You shall avoid every trap of the enemy. You shall walk in divine wisdom and supernatural understanding in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I take authority over every spirit of confusion in your life. Every cloud of confusion hanging over your mind, I command it to clear right now in the name of Jesus. You shall have clarity of thought. You shall have clarity of vision. You shall have clarity of purpose. You shall know what to do, where to go, and whom to connect with. Your steps shall be ordered by the Lord in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I decree and declare that you are the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. You are not a sinner struggling with sin. You are a saint who occasionally makes mistakes. You are forgiven. You are justified. You are sanctified. You are holy and blameless before God through the blood of Jesus Christ. Walk in your identity as a child of God. Walk in your righteousness in Christ. Let no demon intimidate you. Let no accuser condemn you. You are accepted in the beloved in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Romans [music] 8:1 declares, "There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the spirit. Every voice of condemnation speaking against you, I silence it by the blood of Jesus. Every accusation of the enemy, I nullify it in the name of Jesus. You are not condemned. You are not rejected. You are loved by God. You are treasured by heaven. You are precious to your father in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. By the blood of Jesus, I destroy every work of the enemy in your life. Every plan of Satan, I frustrate it in the name of Jesus. Every scheme of darkness, I expose it and destroy it in the name of Jesus. The enemy shall not succeed against you. The devil shall not triumph over you. You are more than a conqueror through him who loved you. You are victorious because Christ has already won the victory in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Father, I pray for manifestation of all that you have spoken concerning each life here tonight. Every prophetic word that has been released over your life, I decree fulfillment in the name of Jesus. Every promise that God has made to you, I decree manifestation in the name of Jesus. What God has said shall surely come to pass. What heaven has decreed shall surely be established. You shall see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I decree and declare that signs and wonders shall follow you. Miracles shall locate you. Breakthrough shall pursue you. Testimonies shall multiply in your life. People shall see what God is doing in your life. And they shall glorify your father in heaven. Your life shall be a demonstration of God's power. Your testimony shall be a proof of God's faithfulness. Your success shall be evidence of God's favor in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. By the authority of heaven, I decree that you are candidate for divine visitation. God is about to visit you personally. God is about to show up in your situation. God is about to prove himself strong on your behalf. What you about to experience will leave you speechless. What you are about to testify will make others seek the Lord. Your breakthrough is not ordinary. It is supernatural and it is coming speedily in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. [music] Thus said the spirit of the living God.
